verdict.rationale: Licensing and governance are a fair question for an open-source infrastructure control plane, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents Crossplane's license, foundation stewardship, or governance model. The one related community remark (comm-9) is a user musing about a vendor-neutral company model for hosting, not evidence of an open license or open governance.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can rely on an open license and open governance so the tool cannot be relicensed out from under my company
